title: A Handful of Peppercorns: The Cannons Istanbul Sent to Sumatra
summary: Tells how the Aceh Sultanate in Sumatra asked Istanbul for help against Portugal in the fifteen sixties, how the envoys who arrived with a shipload of black pepper were kept waiting at the palace for a year, and how the gunners, founders and engineers dispatched by Selim the Second established the Ottomans' easternmost military reach. The episode ranges from the fleet diverted from its course by the revolt in Yemen to Kurtoğlu Hızır Reis's voyage of fifteen sixty-eight to fifteen sixty-nine, the giant cannons cast in Aceh, and the failure of the siege of Malacca.
